annotations.coverageReview: Fresh six-view survey, native front/side frames and original/revised overlays actually inspected. Leviathan has one head. Upper eye/cheek, nose, lower white chin and side lower jaw are covered. Original side pick landed on a projecting whisker and was replaced with a .055-radius jaw-tip patch, independently reviewed. Minimum battle patch 39 vertices. New animation/technique review remains pending.

review.name: Tidelord Leviathan
findings: Fresh source complete-face/body review confirms lower jaw and cheek shearing in strike, recoil and defeat. All 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected front/side; limbs and tail remain connected. Extend the head binding through the independent lower-jaw patches with a smooth neck transition. Sculpt, rig, textures and animation curves preserved; candidate only until independent and repeat visual checks pass.

All 12 candidate raw slices and 216 actual technique frames actually inspected and pass. Final second pass: all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 actual equipped-technique frames and all 16 atlas cells actually inspected and pass. Original geometry, topology, UVs, textures, rig and all animation curves preserved. No model reduction was required beyond regenerating the existing battle LOD. Local only; whole-roster/main/live release remain pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-legendary-018-jaw-v1-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual equipped techniques inspected front/side at twelve times each. Jaw, eyes, horns and whiskers stay aligned. Neck blends continuously into the chest; arms, legs and tail stay connected throughout strike, cast, guard and recovery.
